issue.title: Add the Saved Template (template shelf) glossary term
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-8b.2 note #2, bob-cli-8b.3 note #2, and bob-cli-8b.5 note #2 (epic bob-cli-8b, plan plan:202610/saved_capture_templates.md). The epic's auto decision `memory_saved_template_glossary = no` skipped this strand, so no memory was changed in the epic. This bead is the glossary half; the decision record is bob-cli-8h. Small: one fully specified term from the accepted plan.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Add a glossary strand `glossary:saved-template` (alias: template shelf) with `/sase_memory_write`: a template block (the `@@template:` definition lines, never rows) that bob saved after a successful real `@@template:` capture, stored in bob's per-machine shelf at `$XDG_STATE_HOME/bob-cli/capture/templates.json` (override `BOB_CAPTURE_TEMPLATES_FILE`, capped by `capture.max_saved_templates`), and reused through Bob Mac Capture's Control-T shelf or `bob capture-templates`. Link `[[bulk-capture]]` (and `[[capture]]`), and once bob-cli-8h lands, `[[decisions:saved-templates-are-checked-out]]`.

issue.creation_reason: Three bob-cli-8b phases proposed this term after the epic's auto decision skipped it; the shelf is now a user-facing concept with no glossary entry.

payload.description: Decision-record half of the same bob-cli-8b memory follow-up; link the glossary term to it
